limitations:
Read verified campaign artifacts. No analyzer, JVM, build, or profile process is started.
Packet counts are exact events, not retained facts. Census rows are end-state annotations.
CPU deltas interpolate one-second /proc process samples; they are not CPU-stack shares.
Loop-method diagnostics cover at most 24 completed owners; aborted owners are the union of two top-12 samples.
N2 selectedCall*/persistedReplay* describe physical inter-method calls. Local BlockSummaryLinks do not increment those service counters.
START-to-END arithmetic differences include gauges/peaks; only cumulative counter fields mean event work. Peak/gauge changes must not be reported as work avoided.
New census admitted/outgoing includes public+internal rows; publicAdmitted/publicOutgoing subtract the separately logged block census.

An unfinished run has no frozen completed body/census; BODY_WORK_STATISTICS snapshotActors=0 from an aborted RunResult is not zero performed work. Aborted hot-owner steps are stopped-owner evidence, not a complete frontier.
End-state store counts, cumulative events, sampled allocation churn, RSS, and retained heap are different measurements.
Equal run index/direction/limit is necessary for workload comparison; changed scoped frontiers mean equal inputs/work are not guaranteed.

A trust boundary can be thought of as line drawn through a program. On one side
of the line, data is untrusted. On the other side of the line, data is assumed
to be trustworthy. The purpose of validation logic is to allow data to safely
cross the trust boundary - to move from untrusted to trusted. A trust boundary
violation occurs when a program blurs the line between what is trusted and what
is untrusted. By combining trusted and untrusted data in the same data
structure, it becomes easier for programmers to mistakenly trust unvalidated
data.

A zero maximum or no nonzero logged rows does not prove that all layouts have no gaps. Repeated owner rows in different runs describe the same structural program layout, not new loops. N2 selectedCall*/persistedReplay* describe physical inter-method calls. Local BlockSummaryLinks do not increment those service counters.
START-to-END arithmetic differences include gauges/peaks; only cumulative counter fields mean event work. Peak/gauge changes must not be reported as work avoided.
New census admitted/outgoing includes public+internal rows; publicAdmitted/publicOutgoing subtract the separately logged block census.

An unfinished run has no frozen completed body/census; BODY_WORK_STATISTICS snapshotActors=0 from an aborted RunResult is not zero performed work. Aborted hot-owner steps are stopped-owner evidence, not a complete frontier.
End-state store counts, cumulative events, sampled allocation churn, RSS, and retained heap are different measurements.
Equal run index/direction/limit is necessary for workload comparison; changed scoped frontiers mean equal inputs/work are not guaranteed.

normalExitGaps.coverage: This is a sample of logged original method owners, not an all-method layout census. A zero maximum or no nonzero logged rows does not prove that all layouts have no gaps. Repeated owner rows in different runs describe the same structural program layout, not new loops. Each positive certificate is a layout qualification: no common normal exit was certified; the analyzer retains original physical routes. This reader never selects a replacement target.

limitations:
Read verified campaign artifacts. No analyzer, JVM, build, or profile process is started.
Packet counts are exact events, not retained facts. Census rows are end-state annotations.
CPU deltas interpolate one-second /proc process samples; they are not CPU-stack shares.
Loop-method diagnostics cover at most 24 completed owners; aborted owners are the union of two top-12 samples.
N2 selectedCall*/persistedReplay* describe physical inter-method calls. Local BlockSummaryLinks do not increment those service counters.
START-to-END arithmetic differences include gauges/peaks; only cumulative counter fields mean event work. Peak/gauge changes must not be reported as work avoided.
New census admitted/outgoing includes public+internal rows; publicAdmitted/publicOutgoing subtract the separately logged block census.

An unfinished run has no frozen completed body/census; BODY_WORK_STATISTICS snapshotActors=0 from an aborted RunResult is not zero performed work. Aborted hot-owner steps are stopped-owner evidence, not a complete frontier.
End-state store counts, cumulative events, sampled allocation churn, RSS, and retained heap are different measurements.
Equal run index/direction/limit is necessary for workload comparison; changed scoped frontiers mean equal inputs/work are not guaranteed.

message.text: If an attacker can supply values that the application then uses to determine which class to instantiate or which method to invoke, the potential exists for the attacker to create control flow paths through the application that were not intended by the application developers. historicalReview.limit: The prior run-2 timed out. The exact first lost transfer/permission was not captured; timeout and remaining guide counts do not prove eventual recovery.

caveats: Preexisting does not mean acceptable, false positive, or fixed. The strict f945 gate still records every missing identity.
Trace multiplicity and code-flow counts do not define sink identity; complete occurrence rows remain evidence.
Same method/rule at another return is not an automatic replacement for a missing fingerprint.
Historical source evidence is reused as a documented mechanism, not presented as a new measured runtime lineage.
Latest run labels here come from the command summary; cross-check exact positive engine/report markers for final acceptance.

memoryObservation.limits:
Read existing memory observations only. Never attach to the analyzer.

GC after-pause occupancy is not a dominator/live-heap census. G1 young pauses
can leave unreachable old objects. RSS includes heap commitment and native pages.
Cumulative reclaimed bytes describe churn, not retained ownership.

normalExitGaps.coverage: This is a sample of logged original method owners, not an all-method layout census. Completed runs log at most 24 loop owners ranked by steps; aborted runs log the union of the top 12 by steps and top 12 by candidate offers (at most 24 owners, possibly fewer loop owners). maxLoggedGapsPerOwner is the maximum certificate count among logged owners only. A zero maximum or no nonzero logged rows does not prove that all layouts have no gaps. Repeated owner rows in different runs describe the same structural program layout, not new loops. Each positive certificate is a layout qualification: no common normal exit was certified; the analyzer retains original physical routes. This reader never selects a replacement target.

limitations:
Read verified campaign artifacts. No analyzer, JVM, build, or profile process is started.
Packet counts are exact events, not retained facts. Census rows are end-state annotations.
CPU deltas interpolate one-second /proc process samples; they are not CPU-stack shares.
Loop-method diagnostics cover at most 24 completed owners; aborted owners are the union of two top-12 samples.

interpretationLimits: All four commands ended. OWASP and conductor engines converged. Thingsboard and Stirling timed out; their last accepted forward reports are provisional snapshots.
Sink fingerprint plus full method signature defines identity; multiplicity is separate. All non-retained identities and full occurrence rows are embedded in each quality.details map.
Still missing from86ad means preexisting, not acceptable or proved false positive. Every f945 missing identity remains a strict quality gap.
Official engineTime excludes joined static completion. BIDI_BARRIER_END reports the barrier and full iteration; logger-clock windows are not independent engine timers.
Demand/frontier rows, concrete memberships, processed packets and candidate offers are different units. Internal scoped block rows do not create new original MethodKeys.
Failed/TIMEOUT BODY_WORK_STATISTICS snapshotActors=0 is an empty frozen result, not zero work. No complete frontier exists for the timed-out run.
Process CPU is an interpolation of approximately1s /proc samples; sampled peak RSS includes native memory and committed heap.
GC after-pause occupancy is not live/retained heap. Young collections can leave unreachable old objects; cumulative reclaimed bytes measure churn, not simultaneous memory.
High-memory warnings are not an OOM stop. No exact MemoryManager/JVM OOM marker or heap snapshot exists in this campaign.
All reported normalExitGaps are0 in sampled hot-owner logs; this is not whole-layout coverage.
The campaign quality gate failed, so workload reductions are observations and not accepted semantics-preserving speedup claims.
The source-pinned direct JFR reader matched6188 exact Stirling controls of the independent JSON reader with zero differences. Observer component classification uses its recorded anchor policy.
JFR Java-stack shares and async-profiler all-stack CPU shares have distinct denominators. Nested observer components have only observer samples as denominator; do not add them to top-level shares.
No contributor-cache or ND-join stack was sampled in the checked Stirling run6/run7 captures; absence of a sample does not prove zero calls or allocations.
Three additional native fidelity test classes all pass and do not reproduce the real remaining OWASP miss. Successful read-only JIR lowering is not a successful project engine trace.
Thingsboard run1 selected-event coverage begins about2.3s after its phase begins; its continuous phase does not have full selected-event-envelope coverage.
The prior86ad Thingsboard backward run2 window lasts317.713s; the current timeout window lasts515.656s. Allocation totals and aborted engine totals are not equal-work speed measurements.

qualifications: ExecutionSample counts and shares describe sampled Java-thread stacks; native GC/compiler CPU is absent. Collapsed CPU captures include native stacks and have separate denominators.
Allocation weight is a statistical estimate of allocation churn, not retained heap or exact allocated bytes. Allocation callsite is the first bidi frame in the allocation stack.
Profiles with aborted final runs have unequal iteration windows. Compare window durations and rates; whole-run totals do not establish a regression.
CPU sample shares do not directly divide wall time. Profiling windows overlap; never sum cumulative JFR snapshots.
Observer component categories select the deepest matching semantic operation in an observer stack; one sample belongs to one component. They are not added to top-level scopes.
Current source-pinned direct JFR interpreter independently matched6188 controls of the original Stirling JSON interpreter with zero differences.
Any reported zero sample count is absence of sampled evidence in this capture, not proof that the operation never runs.

Cumulative counters, batch/packet events, admitted rows, CPU samples, allocation weights, RSS and retained heap have different units. Callback counts can vary with batching.

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi

import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.AccessPathBase
import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.ElementAccessor
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.driver.FixedLimits
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.fixtures.DriverFixtures
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.CallPoint.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.StageKind.*
import kotlin.test.*
import kotlin.time.Duration.Companion.seconds

/** External draft: BenchmarkTest01875's real helper adds an independent encoder
 * marker and a same-DATA conditional source between the loop and joined sink.
 * No predefined summaries or hand-built demand/cache records are used. */
class LoopBlockEncoderContributorTest {
    private fun run(withLoop: Boolean) {
        val exactArray = true
        val conditionalSession = false
        DriverFixtures().use { f ->
            val p = f.program
            // ENTRY metadata: request/$REQ.
            // cookies=request.getCookies(); // CM(this,$REQ) -> ret.$/DATA + ret.[].$/DATA.
            // while (again()) { param=cookies[i]; if (match()) break; }
            // bar=doSomething(request,param); // real conditional same-DATA producer.
            // session=request.getSession(); // ZERO -> ret.$/SESSION.
            // session.setAttribute(bar,"value"); // CM(this,SESSION) AND CM(arg0,DATA).
            val method = p.method("trust boundary encoder caller loop=$withLoop", listOf(
                listOf(1), listOf(2), listOf(3, 6), listOf(4), listOf(5),
                if (withLoop) listOf(2, 6) else listOf(6), listOf(7), listOf(8), listOf(9), emptyList(), emptyList()),
                normalExit = 9, exceptionalExit = 10, backwardExitDiscovery = true).key()
            val helper = p.method("trust boundary doSomething encoder helper", listOf(
                listOf(1), listOf(2), listOf(3), emptyList(), emptyList()),
                normalExit = 3, exceptionalExit = 4, backwardExitDiscovery = true).key()
            val request = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
            val cookies = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
            val param = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(1)
            val session = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(2)
            val cookie = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(3)
            val bar = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(4)
            val encoder = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
            val helperBar = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(1)
            val helperData = AccessPathBase.Argument(1)
            val sourceArg = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
            val receiver = AccessPathBase.This
            val returned = AccessPathBase.Return
            val sinkArg = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
            val req = MarkSlot.Concrete(p.mark("T"))
            val data = MarkSlot.Concrete(p.mark("U"))
            val boundSession = MarkSlot.Concrete(p.mark("V"))
            val encoderMark = MarkSlot.Concrete(p.mark("W"))
            val element = f.manager.accessors.index(ElementAccessor)
            val owner = FormOwner()
            fun occurrence(at: Int, kind: RuleKind) = RuleOccurrenceId(
                FormKey(owner, method.method, method, p.inst(method, at)), kind, 0)
            val entryId = occurrence(0, RuleKind.ENTRY_SOURCE)
            val entryAction = ActionId(entryId, ActionRole.SOURCE, 0)
            val entryEdge = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, p.pattern(request, mark = req).fact, ExclusionSet.Empty)
            p.entry(method, RuleStatement(MicroEdgeBuilder().apply {
                keepZero(); sourceEdge(entryEdge, entryAction)
            }.build(), StatementSummary.EMPTY, emptyList()))

            fun sourceCall(at: Int, output: AccessPathBase, targets: List<PathFact>,
                           conditional: Boolean = true): List<Pair<PathEdge, ActionId>> {
                val condition = p.pattern(receiver, mark = req)
                val builder = RulePredicate.Builder(f.cancellation, f.manager.marks)
                val id = occurrence(at, RuleKind.CALL_SOURCE)

                normalExit = 9, exceptionalExit = 10, backwardExitDiscovery = true).key()

            val owner = FormOwner()

                FormKey(owner, method.method, method, p.inst(method, at)), kind, 0)

            val entryAction = ActionId(entryId, ActionRole.SOURCE, 0)

                    CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, StatementSummary.EMPTY),
                    CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),

                        starEdge(receiver, emptyList(), request, emptyList()),
                        starEdge(returned, emptyList(), output, emptyList()))),

                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, f.summary(
                    starEdge(receiver, emptyList(), returned, emptyList()))),
                CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, f.summary(
                    starEdge(receiver, emptyList(), cookie, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(returned, emptyList(), param, emptyList()))),
            ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER))

            // automaton. Its generated receiver marker is an unconditional
            // typed ZERO source; it need not check the SOURCE automaton's REQ.
            // Actual BenchmarkTest01875.doSomething(request,param):
            //   encoder = ESAPI.encoder();
            //   bar = encoder.encodeForHTML(param);
            //   return bar;
            // Serialized trust-boundary source14 supplies ENCODER at ZERO.
            // Source15 requires both ENCODER/this and DATA/arg0 and assigns
            // the same DATA mark. Keep its redundant OR to match the metadata.

                FormKey(owner, helper.method, helper, p.inst(helper, at)), kind, ordinal)
            val encoderId = helperOccurrence(0, RuleKind.CALL_SOURCE, 14)
            val encoderAction = ActionId(encoderId, ActionRole.SOURCE, 0)
            val encoderSource = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, p.pattern(returned, mark = encoderMark).fact, ExclusionSet.Empty)
            val encoderSummary = MicroEdgeBuilder().apply { keepZero(); sourceEdge(encoderSource, encoderAction) }.buildStage()
            p.call(helper, 0, CallPlan(setOf(encoder), listOf(
                CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP)),
                CallStage.Edges(BOUND, REWRITTEN, SOURCES, encoderSummary),
                CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, StatementSummary.EMPTY),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, StatementSummary.EMPTY),
                CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, f.summary(
                    starEdge(returned, emptyList(), encoder, emptyList()))),
            ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER))
            val encodeBuilder = RulePredicate.Builder(f.cancellation, f.manager.marks)
            val argumentLeaf = encodeBuilder.leaf(p.pattern(sourceArg, mark = data))
            val encoderLeaf = encodeBuilder.leaf(p.pattern(receiver, mark = encoderMark))
            val encodePredicate = encodeBuilder.build(encodeBuilder.and(listOf(
                encodeBuilder.or(listOf(argumentLeaf, encoderLeaf)), encoderLeaf, argumentLeaf)))
            val encodeId = helperOccurrence(1, RuleKind.CALL_SOURCE, 15)
            val encodeAction = SourceAction(ActionId(encodeId, ActionRole.SOURCE, 0),
                p.pattern(returned, mark = data).fact)
            val encodeSource = SourceRuleOccurrence(encodeId, encodePredicate, listOf(encodeAction))
            val encodeSummary = MicroEdgeBuilder().apply { keepZero(); source(encodeSource) }.buildStage()
            // The explicit SOURCES branch ends at REWRITTEN, so it bypasses
            // the generated return reset. The unresolved branch cannot bypass
            // the conditional rule through ordinary CopyAllMarks(arg0,ret).
            val resetData = CleanStep.Clean(Cleaner(returned, null, CleanReach.EXACT, data.mark))
            val resetEncoder = CleanStep.Clean(Cleaner(returned, null, CleanReach.EXACT, encoderMark.mark))
            p.call(helper, 1, CallPlan(setOf(encoder, helperData, helperBar), listOf(
                CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP,
                    starEdge(encoder, emptyList(), receiver, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(helperData, emptyList(), sourceArg, emptyList()))),
                CallStage.Edges(BOUND, REWRITTEN, SOURCES, encodeSummary),
                CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, f.summary(
                    keepEdge(receiver), keepEdge(sourceArg))),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, f.summary(
                    starEdge(receiver, emptyList(), returned, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(sourceArg, emptyList(), returned, emptyList()))),
                CallStage.Actions.run1FullReturnRewriter(listOf(resetData, resetEncoder), f.manager.marks),
                CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, f.summary(
                    starEdge(receiver, emptyList(), encoder, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(sourceArg, emptyList(), helperData, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(returned, emptyList(), helperBar, emptyList()))),
            ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER))
            p.statement(helper, 2, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP,
                starEdge(helperBar, emptyList(), returned, emptyList())))
            p.call(method, 6, CallPlan(setOf(request, param, bar), listOf(
                CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP,
                    keepEdge(request), starEdge(param, emptyList(), helperData, emptyList()))),
                CallStage.Edges(BOUND, REWRITTEN, SOURCES, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP)),
                CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Callees(ADDED, RETURNED, listOf(helper)),
                CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, f.summary(
                    keepEdge(request), starEdge(helperData, emptyList(), param, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(returned, emptyList(), bar, emptyList()))),
            ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER))
            val sessionSources = sourceCall(7, session,
                listOf(p.pattern(returned, mark = boundSession).fact), conditionalSession)
            val sinkBuilder = RulePredicate.Builder(f.cancellation, f.manager.marks)
            val predicate = sinkBuilder.build(sinkBuilder.and(listOf(
                sinkBuilder.leaf(p.pattern(receiver, mark = boundSession)),
                sinkBuilder.leaf(p.pattern(sinkArg, mark = data)),
            )))
            val sink = SinkRule(f.rule("trust boundary receiver and value"), 0, predicate.leaves,
                emptyList(), occurrence(8, RuleKind.CALL_SINK), predicate)
            val bound = f.summary(keepEdge(receiver), keepEdge(sinkArg))
            p.call(method, 8, CallPlan(setOf(session, bar), listOf(
                CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP,
                    starEdge(session, emptyList(), receiver, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(bar, emptyList(), sinkArg, emptyList()))),
                CallStage.Edges(BOUND, REWRITTEN, SOURCES, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP)),
                CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, bound),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, StatementSummary.EMPTY),
                CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, f.summary(
                    starEdge(receiver, emptyList(), session, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(sinkArg, emptyList(), bar, emptyList()))),
            ), listOf(sink), BEFORE, AFTER))
            val driver = f.driver(FixedLimits(listOf(1, 1, 2, 3, 4)), 20.seconds, run1MarkMode = MarkMode.FULL)
            val report = driver.analyze(listOf(method))
            if (report.entries.none { it.descriptor.key.ruleId == sink.rule.id }) println(buildString {
                fun image(original: PremiseKey, value: Facts) =
                    "${original.members.map { it.toPattern() }} -> ${f.ops.leaves(value).toList()} layer=${value.layer}"
                appendLine("ENCODER_CONTRIBUTOR_TRACE loop=$withLoop exactArray=$exactArray conditionalSession=$conditionalSession end=${report.end}")
                for (config in f.configs) appendLine("config=${config.index} entryPermission=${config.seeds.allowsSource(method,p.inst(method,0),entryEdge,entryAction)} cookiePermissions=${cookieSources.map { config.seeds.allowsSource(method,p.inst(method,1),it.first,it.second) }} sessionPermissions=${sessionSources.map { config.seeds.allowsSource(method,p.inst(method,7),it.first,it.second) }}")
                for (config in f.configs) {

                    if (config.index > 1) {
                        val actualData = f.manager.factsOf(p.pattern(helperData,mark=data).fact,ExclusionSet.Empty,Layer.NORMAL)
                        val demand = checkNotNull(config.demand)
                        val retExact = f.manager.factsOf(p.pattern(returned,mark=data).fact,ExclusionSet.Empty,Layer.NORMAL)
                        val retAny = f.manager.factsOf(p.pattern(returned,tail=Tail.ANY,mark=data).fact,ExclusionSet.Empty,Layer.DEMAND)

                    }
                    appendLine("HELPER_OFFERS run=${config.index} offers=${f.links(config.index,helper)}")
                }
                for (frontier in driver.frontiers) appendLine("frontier=${frontier.run} demand=${frontier.demandEdges} targetDemand=${frontier.targetDemand} reports=${frontier.reportedSinks}")
                if (withLoop) {
                    val layout = f.shared.contexts.blockLayout(method)
                    val after = checkNotNull(layout[layout.root].after)
                    val first = f.results.first { it.runIndex == 1 }.analyzers.single { it.key == method }
                    val scopes = first.blockSummaries().filter { it.key.scope.block == after }.map { it.key.scope }.distinct().toList()
                    val dataInput = f.manager.factsOf(p.pattern(param, mark = data).fact, ExclusionSet.Empty, Layer.NORMAL)
                    for (config in f.configs.filter { it.index >= 3 && it.direction == Direction.FORWARD }) for (scope in scopes) {
                        val view = checkNotNull(config.demand).scope(method, scope)
                        appendLine("C2 run=${config.index} scope=$scope ZERO=${view.initials(Reach.NORMAL, config.admissionPolicy)} DATA=${view.initials(dataInput, config.admissionPolicy).map { it.initial.toPattern() to it.layer }}")
                        val saved = f.records.byEntry(method, scope, f.manager.zero.toPattern()).filter { record ->

                            }

                        appendLine("SAVED_SESSION scope=$scope rows=${saved.map { image(it.premise,it.conclusion) }}")
                    }
                }
                for (result in f.results) for (actor in result.analyzers) {
                    appendLine("CONTRIBUTORS run=${result.runIndex} method=${actor.key.method.name} captured=${actor.normalRuleContributors.capturedRows} restored=${actor.normalRuleContributors.restoredRows}")
                    for (row in actor.normalContributorRows()) appendLine("CERT run=${result.runIndex} method=${actor.key.method.name} key=${row.key} leaf=${row.leaf} ${image(row.input.premise,checkNotNull(row.input.facts))}")
                    appendLine("run=${result.runIndex} method=${actor.key.method.name} ROOT targets=${actor.targets} sourceHits=${actor.sourceHits?.occurrences()?.toList()}")
                    for ((original, value) in actor.summaries.all()) appendLine("run=${result.runIndex} ROOT ${image(original,value)}")
                    for (block in actor.blockSummaries()) for ((original,value) in block.summaries.all())
                        appendLine("run=${result.runIndex} BLOCK=${block.key} ${image(original,value)}")
                    for (block in actor.blockTargets()) for (row in block.rows)
                        appendLine("run=${result.runIndex} TARGET scope=${block.scope} original=${row.premise.members.map { it.toPattern() }} target=${row.target}")
                    for (block in actor.blockOutgoingTargets()) for (row in block.rows)
                        appendLine("run=${result.runIndex} OUT_TARGET scope=${block.scope} original=${row.premise.members.map { it.toPattern() }} target=${row.target}")
                }
                for (row in f.processed.filter { it.method==helper || it.delta.node.location.index>=6 }) appendLine("run=${row.run} method=${row.method.method.name} at=${row.delta.node.location.index} ${image(row.delta.premise,row.delta.facts)}")
            })
            assertEquals(RunStatus.COMPLETE, report.end.status)
            assertEquals(listOf(sink.rule.id), report.entries.map { it.descriptor.key.ruleId }, "end=${report.end}")
            assertEquals(p.inst(method,8), report.entries.single().descriptor.key.statement)
            assertTrue(f.results.flatMap { it.analyzers }.all { it.key in setOf(method,helper) })
        }
    }

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi

import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.AccessPathBase
import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.ElementAccessor
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*

import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.CallPoint.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.StageKind.*
import kotlin.test.*
import kotlin.time.Duration.Companion.seconds

/** Unrun /tmp control: add URLDecoder static call after JIR no-ZERO/split-unresolved shape.
 * External draft: BenchmarkTest01875's real helper adds an independent encoder
 * marker and a same-DATA conditional source between the loop and joined sink.
 * No predefined summaries or hand-built demand/cache records are used. */
class LoopBlockEncoderDecodeShapeControlTest {
    private fun run(withLoop: Boolean) {
        val exactArray = true
        val conditionalSession = false
        DriverFixtures().use { f ->
            val p = f.program
            // ENTRY metadata: request/$REQ.
            // cookies=request.getCookies(); // CM(this,$REQ) -> ret.$/DATA + ret.[].$/DATA.
            // while (again()) { param=cookies[i]; if (match()) break; }
            // bar=doSomething(request,param); // real conditional same-DATA producer.
            // session=request.getSession(); // ZERO -> ret.$/SESSION.
            // session.setAttribute(bar,"value"); // CM(this,SESSION) AND CM(arg0,DATA).
            val method = p.method("trust boundary encoder caller loop=$withLoop", listOf(
                listOf(1), listOf(2), listOf(3, 6), listOf(4), listOf(11),
                if (withLoop) listOf(2, 6) else listOf(6), listOf(7), listOf(8), listOf(9), emptyList(), emptyList(), listOf(5)),
                normalExit = 9, exceptionalExit = 10, backwardExitDiscovery = true).key()
            val helper = p.method("trust boundary doSomething encoder helper", listOf(
                listOf(1), listOf(2), listOf(3), emptyList(), emptyList()),
                normalExit = 3, exceptionalExit = 4, backwardExitDiscovery = true).key()
            val request = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
            val cookies = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
            val param = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(1)
            val session = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(2)
            val cookie = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(3)
            val bar = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(4)
            val cookieValue = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(5)
            val encoding = AccessPathBase.Constant("java.lang.String", "UTF-8")
            val encodingArg = AccessPathBase.Argument(1)
            val encoder = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
            val helperBar = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(1)
            val helperData = AccessPathBase.Argument(1)
            val sourceArg = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
            val receiver = AccessPathBase.This
            val returned = AccessPathBase.Return
            val sinkArg = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
            val req = MarkSlot.Concrete(p.mark("T"))
            val data = MarkSlot.Concrete(p.mark("U"))
            val boundSession = MarkSlot.Concrete(p.mark("V"))
            val encoderMark = MarkSlot.Concrete(p.mark("W"))
            val element = f.manager.accessors.index(ElementAccessor)
            val owner = FormOwner()
            fun occurrence(at: Int, kind: RuleKind) = RuleOccurrenceId(
                FormKey(owner, method.method, method, p.inst(method, at)), kind, 0)
            val entryId = occurrence(0, RuleKind.ENTRY_SOURCE)
            val entryAction = ActionId(entryId, ActionRole.SOURCE, 0)
            val entryEdge = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, p.pattern(request, mark = req).fact, ExclusionSet.Empty)
            p.entry(method, RuleStatement(MicroEdgeBuilder().apply {
                keepZero(); sourceEdge(entryEdge, entryAction)
            }.build(), StatementSummary.EMPTY, emptyList()))

            fun sourceCall(at: Int, output: AccessPathBase, targets: List<PathFact>,
                           conditional: Boolean = true): List<Pair<PathEdge, ActionId>> {
                val condition = p.pattern(receiver, mark = req)
                val builder = RulePredicate.Builder(f.cancellation, f.manager.marks)
                val id = occurrence(at, RuleKind.CALL_SOURCE)
                val actions = targets.mapIndexed { index, target -> SourceAction(ActionId(id, ActionRole.SOURCE, index), target) }
                val source = if (conditional) SourceRuleOccurrence(id, builder.build(builder.leaf(condition)), actions) else null
                val transfers = actions.map { action ->
                    (source?.transfer(condition, action)?.forward
                        ?: PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, action.target, ExclusionSet.Empty)) to action.id
                }
                // JIRCallPlanBuilder's source branch bypasses return cleanup;
                // ordinary receiver identity is a separate unresolved branch.
                val sources = MicroEdgeBuilder().apply {
                    keepZero()
                    if (source != null) source(source)
                    else transfers.forEach { (edge, action) -> sourceEdge(edge, action) }
                }.buildStage()
                p.call(method, at, CallPlan(setOf(request, output), listOf(
                    CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP,
                        starEdge(request, emptyList(), receiver, emptyList()))),
                    CallStage.Edges(BOUND, REWRITTEN, SOURCES, sources),
                    CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
                    CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, f.summary(keepEdge(receiver))),
                    CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, StatementSummary.EMPTY),
                    CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
                    CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, f.summary(
                        starEdge(receiver, emptyList(), request, emptyList()),
                        starEdge(returned, emptyList(), output, emptyList()))),
                ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER))
                return transfers
            }
            // resolveWithArray expands BaseOnly array-result assignment to root
            // and element EXACT actions. It does not imply a MUST source.
            val cookieTargets = if (exactArray) listOf(
                p.pattern(returned, mark = data).fact,
                p.pattern(returned, listOf(element), mark = data).fact,
            ) else listOf(p.pattern(returned, tail = Tail.ANY_TAINT, mark = data).fact)
            val cookieSources = sourceCall(1, cookies, cookieTargets)
            p.statement(method, 3, MicroEdgeBuilder().apply { read(cookie, cookies, listOf(element)) }.build())
            // The ordinary get-value model is CopyAllMarks(This,Result), from
            // JIRMethodGetDefault.defaultPropagationRules + JIRRuleForms.pass.
            p.call(method, 4, CallPlan(setOf(cookie, cookieValue), listOf(
                CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP,
                    starEdge(cookie, emptyList(), receiver, emptyList()))),
                CallStage.Edges(BOUND, REWRITTEN, SOURCES, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP)),
                CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, f.summary(keepEdge(receiver))),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, f.summary(
                    starEdge(receiver, emptyList(), returned, emptyList()))),
                CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, f.summary(
                    starEdge(receiver, emptyList(), cookie, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(returned, emptyList(), cookieValue, emptyList()))),
            ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER))
            // model/java/config/stdlib/java-net.yaml:921 is CopyAllMarks(arg0,Result)
            // for decode(String,String). This is an ordinary pass, without a
            // mark predicate or trust-boundary producer action.
            p.call(method, 11, CallPlan(setOf(cookieValue, encoding, param), listOf(
                CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP,
                    starEdge(cookieValue, emptyList(), sourceArg, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(encoding, emptyList(), encodingArg, emptyList()))),
                CallStage.Edges(BOUND, REWRITTEN, SOURCES, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP)),
                CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, f.summary(
                    keepEdge(sourceArg), keepEdge(encodingArg))),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, f.summary(
                    starEdge(sourceArg, emptyList(), returned, emptyList()))),
                CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, f.summary(
                    starEdge(sourceArg, emptyList(), cookieValue, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(returned, emptyList(), param, emptyList()))),
            ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER))
            // The first getSession step belongs to the independent SINK pattern
            // automaton. Its generated receiver marker is an unconditional
            // typed ZERO source; it need not check the SOURCE automaton's REQ.
            // Actual BenchmarkTest01875.doSomething(request,param):
            //   encoder = ESAPI.encoder();
            //   bar = encoder.encodeForHTML(param);
            //   return bar;
            // Serialized trust-boundary source14 supplies ENCODER at ZERO.
            // Source15 requires both ENCODER/this and DATA/arg0 and assigns
            // the same DATA mark. Keep its redundant OR to match the metadata.
            fun helperOccurrence(at: Int, kind: RuleKind, ordinal: Int = 0) = RuleOccurrenceId(
                FormKey(owner, helper.method, helper, p.inst(helper, at)), kind, ordinal)
            val encoderId = helperOccurrence(0, RuleKind.CALL_SOURCE, 14)
            val encoderAction = ActionId(encoderId, ActionRole.SOURCE, 0)
            val encoderSource = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, p.pattern(returned, mark = encoderMark).fact, ExclusionSet.Empty)
            val encoderSummary = MicroEdgeBuilder().apply { keepZero(); sourceEdge(encoderSource, encoderAction) }.buildStage()
            p.call(helper, 0, CallPlan(setOf(encoder), listOf(
                CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP)),
                CallStage.Edges(BOUND, REWRITTEN, SOURCES, encoderSummary),
                CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, StatementSummary.EMPTY),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, StatementSummary.EMPTY),
                CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, f.summary(
                    starEdge(returned, emptyList(), encoder, emptyList()))),
            ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER))
            val encodeBuilder = RulePredicate.Builder(f.cancellation, f.manager.marks)
            val argumentLeaf = encodeBuilder.leaf(p.pattern(sourceArg, mark = data))
            val encoderLeaf = encodeBuilder.leaf(p.pattern(receiver, mark = encoderMark))
            val encodePredicate = encodeBuilder.build(encodeBuilder.and(listOf(
                encodeBuilder.or(listOf(argumentLeaf, encoderLeaf)), encoderLeaf, argumentLeaf)))
            val encodeId = helperOccurrence(1, RuleKind.CALL_SOURCE, 15)
            val encodeAction = SourceAction(ActionId(encodeId, ActionRole.SOURCE, 0),
                p.pattern(returned, mark = data).fact)
            val encodeSource = SourceRuleOccurrence(encodeId, encodePredicate, listOf(encodeAction))
            val encodeSummary = MicroEdgeBuilder().apply { keepZero(); source(encodeSource) }.buildStage()
            // The explicit SOURCES branch ends at REWRITTEN, so it bypasses
            // the generated return reset. The unresolved branch cannot bypass
            // the conditional rule through ordinary CopyAllMarks(arg0,ret).
            val resetData = CleanStep.Clean(Cleaner(returned, null, CleanReach.EXACT, data.mark))
            val resetEncoder = CleanStep.Clean(Cleaner(returned, null, CleanReach.EXACT, encoderMark.mark))
            p.call(helper, 1, CallPlan(setOf(encoder, helperData, helperBar), listOf(
                CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP,
                    starEdge(encoder, emptyList(), receiver, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(helperData, emptyList(), sourceArg, emptyList()))),
                CallStage.Edges(BOUND, REWRITTEN, SOURCES, encodeSummary),
                CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, f.summary(
                    keepEdge(receiver), keepEdge(sourceArg))),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, f.summary(
                    starEdge(receiver, emptyList(), returned, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(sourceArg, emptyList(), returned, emptyList()))),
                CallStage.Actions.run1FullReturnRewriter(listOf(resetData, resetEncoder), f.manager.marks),
                CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, f.summary(
                    starEdge(receiver, emptyList(), encoder, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(sourceArg, emptyList(), helperData, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(returned, emptyList(), helperBar, emptyList()))),
            ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER))
            p.statement(helper, 2, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP,
                starEdge(helperBar, emptyList(), returned, emptyList())))
            p.call(method, 6, CallPlan(setOf(request, param, bar), listOf(
                CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP,
                    keepEdge(request), starEdge(param, emptyList(), helperData, emptyList()))),
                CallStage.Edges(BOUND, REWRITTEN, SOURCES, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP)),
                CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Callees(ADDED, RETURNED, listOf(helper)),
                CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, f.summary(
                    keepEdge(request), starEdge(helperData, emptyList(), param, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(returned, emptyList(), bar, emptyList()))),
            ), emptyList(), BEFORE, AFTER))
            val sessionSources = sourceCall(7, session,
                listOf(p.pattern(returned, mark = boundSession).fact), conditionalSession)
            val sinkBuilder = RulePredicate.Builder(f.cancellation, f.manager.marks)
            val predicate = sinkBuilder.build(sinkBuilder.and(listOf(
                sinkBuilder.leaf(p.pattern(receiver, mark = boundSession)),
                sinkBuilder.leaf(p.pattern(sinkArg, mark = data)),
            )))
            val sink = SinkRule(f.rule("trust boundary receiver and value"), 0, predicate.leaves,
                emptyList(), occurrence(8, RuleKind.CALL_SINK), predicate)
            val bound = f.summary(keepEdge(receiver), keepEdge(sinkArg))
            p.call(method, 8, CallPlan(setOf(session, bar), listOf(
                CallStage.Edges(BEFORE, BOUND, BIND_IN, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP,
                    starEdge(session, emptyList(), receiver, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(bar, emptyList(), sinkArg, emptyList()))),
                CallStage.Edges(BOUND, REWRITTEN, SOURCES, f.summary(ZERO_KEEP)),
                CallStage.Actions(BOUND, ADDED, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, bound),
                CallStage.Edges(ADDED, RETURNED, UNRESOLVED, StatementSummary.EMPTY),
                CallStage.Actions(RETURNED, REWRITTEN, emptyList()),
                CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN, AFTER, BIND_BACK, f.summary(
                    starEdge(receiver, emptyList(), session, emptyList()),
                    starEdge(sinkArg, emptyList(), bar, emptyList()))),
            ), listOf(sink), BEFORE, AFTER))
            val driver = f.driver(FixedLimits(listOf(1, 1, 2, 3, 4)), 20.seconds, run1MarkMode = MarkMode.FULL)
            val report = driver.analyze(listOf(method))
            if (report.entries.none { it.descriptor.key.ruleId == sink.rule.id }) println(buildString {
                fun image(original: PremiseKey, value: Facts) =
                    "${original.members.map { it.toPattern() }} -> ${f.ops.leaves(value).toList()} layer=${value.layer}"
                appendLine("ENCODER_CONTRIBUTOR_TRACE loop=$withLoop exactArray=$exactArray conditionalSession=$conditionalSession end=${report.end}")
                for (config in f.configs) appendLine("config=${config.index} entryPermission=${config.seeds.allowsSource(method,p.inst(method,0),entryEdge,entryAction)} cookiePermissions=${cookieSources.map { config.seeds.allowsSource(method,p.inst(method,1),it.first,it.second) }} sessionPermissions=${sessionSources.map { config.seeds.allowsSource(method,p.inst(method,7),it.first,it.second) }}")
                for (config in f.configs) {
                    appendLine("ENCODER_PERMISSION run=${config.index} encoder=${config.seeds.allowsSource(helper,p.inst(helper,0),encoderSource,encoderAction)} encode=${encodeSource.predicate.leaves.map { config.seeds.allowsSource(helper,p.inst(helper,1),encodeSource.transfer(it,encodeAction,multi=true).forward,encodeAction.id) }}")
                    if (config.index > 1) {
                        val actualData = f.manager.factsOf(p.pattern(helperData,mark=data).fact,ExclusionSet.Empty,Layer.NORMAL)
                        val demand = checkNotNull(config.demand)
                        val retExact = f.manager.factsOf(p.pattern(returned,mark=data).fact,ExclusionSet.Empty,Layer.NORMAL)
                        val retAny = f.manager.factsOf(p.pattern(returned,tail=Tail.ANY,mark=data).fact,ExclusionSet.Empty,Layer.DEMAND)
                        appendLine("HELPER_C2 run=${config.index} ZERO=${demand.initials(helper,Reach.NORMAL,config.admissionPolicy)} DATA=${demand.initials(helper,actualData,config.admissionPolicy).map { it.initial.toPattern() to it.layer }} RET_EXACT=${demand.initials(helper,retExact,config.admissionPolicy).map { it.initial.toPattern() to it.layer }} RET_ANY=${demand.initials(helper,retAny,config.admissionPolicy).map { it.initial.toPattern() to it.layer }}")
                    }
                    appendLine("HELPER_OFFERS run=${config.index} offers=${f.links(config.index,helper)}")
                }
                for (frontier in driver.frontiers) appendLine("frontier=${frontier.run} demand=${frontier.demandEdges} targetDemand=${frontier.targetDemand} reports=${frontier.reportedSinks}")
                if (withLoop) {
                    val layout = f.shared.contexts.blockLayout(method)
                    val after = checkNotNull(layout[layout.root].after)
                    val first = f.results.first { it.runIndex == 1 }.analyzers.single { it.key == method }
                    val scopes = first.blockSummaries().filter { it.key.scope.block == after }.map { it.key.scope }.distinct().toList()
                    val dataInput = f.manager.factsOf(p.pattern(param, mark = data).fact, ExclusionSet.Empty, Layer.NORMAL)
                    for (config in f.configs.filter { it.index >= 3 && it.direction == Direction.FORWARD }) for (scope in scopes) {
                        val view = checkNotNull(config.demand).scope(method, scope)
                        appendLine("C2 run=${config.index} scope=$scope ZERO=${view.initials(Reach.NORMAL, config.admissionPolicy)} DATA=${view.initials(dataInput, config.admissionPolicy).map { it.initial.toPattern() to it.layer }}")
                        val saved = f.records.byEntry(method, scope, f.manager.zero.toPattern()).filter { record ->
                            record.direction == Direction.FORWARD && record.premise.isZero && f.ops.leaves(record.conclusion).any {
                                it.fact.base == session && it.fact.mark == boundSession
                            }
                        }.toList()
                        appendLine("SAVED_SESSION scope=$scope rows=${saved.map { image(it.premise,it.conclusion) }}")
                    }
                }
                for (result in f.results) for (actor in result.analyzers) {
                    appendLine("CONTRIBUTORS run=${result.runIndex} method=${actor.key.method.name} captured=${actor.normalRuleContributors.capturedRows} restored=${actor.normalRuleContributors.restoredRows}")
                    for (row in actor.normalContributorRows()) appendLine("CERT run=${result.runIndex} method=${actor.key.method.name} key=${row.key} leaf=${row.leaf} ${image(row.input.premise,checkNotNull(row.input.facts))}")
                    appendLine("run=${result.runIndex} method=${actor.key.method.name} ROOT targets=${actor.targets} sourceHits=${actor.sourceHits?.occurrences()?.toList()}")
                    for ((original, value) in actor.summaries.all()) appendLine("run=${result.runIndex} ROOT ${image(original,value)}")
                    for (block in actor.blockSummaries()) for ((original,value) in block.summaries.all())
                        appendLine("run=${result.runIndex} BLOCK=${block.key} ${image(original,value)}")
                    for (block in actor.blockTargets()) for (row in block.rows)
                        appendLine("run=${result.runIndex} TARGET scope=${block.scope} original=${row.premise.members.map { it.toPattern() }} target=${row.target}")
                    for (block in actor.blockOutgoingTargets()) for (row in block.rows)
                        appendLine("run=${result.runIndex} OUT_TARGET scope=${block.scope} original=${row.premise.members.map { it.toPattern() }} target=${row.target}")
                }
                for (row in f.processed.filter { it.method==helper || it.delta.node.location.index>=6 }) appendLine("run=${row.run} method=${row.method.method.name} at=${row.delta.node.location.index} ${image(row.delta.premise,row.delta.facts)}")
            })
            assertEquals(RunStatus.COMPLETE, report.end.status)
            assertEquals(listOf(sink.rule.id), report.entries.map { it.descriptor.key.ruleId }, "end=${report.end}")
            assertEquals(p.inst(method,8), report.entries.single().descriptor.key.statement)
            assertTrue(f.results.flatMap { it.analyzers }.all { it.key in setOf(method,helper) })
        }
    }
